clips.title: 橡树资本私募信贷基金赎回率降至5%关键门槛以下
title_lines: 私募信贷基金赎回率降至5%以下

subtitles.en: At Oak Tree, one private credit fund saw redemption request drop by almost half with investors seeking to redeem 4.5% in Q2 rather than the 5% offered and the 8.5% recorded in Q1.
subtitles.zh: 橡树资本的一只私募信贷基金赎回请求下降近一半，二季度市场参与者申请赎回4.5%，低于5%的门槛，而一季度为8.5%。
en_highlights: redemption request drop by almost half

subtitles.en: What kinds of conversations, Danielle, are folks having at Oak Tree with investors that has led to this turn?
subtitles.zh: 丹妮尔，橡树资本与市场参与者进行了怎样的沟通，才促成了这一转变？

subtitles.en: I think our investors appreciate the counter-cyclical investment style that we have here at Oak Tree.
subtitles.zh: 我认为市场参与者欣赏我们在橡树资本采取的逆周期**风格。

subtitles.en: And looking at our portfolios, we do have ample liquidity, diversified holdings, and we have been very conservative in what we put into the portfolios.
subtitles.zh: 看我们的**组合，流动性充足，持仓多元化，而且我们在组合构建上一直非常保守。

subtitles.en: So if you look at them, I think they're positioned appropriately, not only for today's environment, but to take advantage of what's ahead.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为它们不仅适合当前环境，还能把握未来机遇。

subtitles.en: And I think that really resonates with investors that we're holding on to liquidity so that we can be flexible and act decisively as opportunities present themselves.
subtitles.zh: 市场参与者非常认同我们保留流动性，以便在机会出现时灵活果断地行动。

subtitles.en: So I think it's a track record that we've built here for many years, leaning on that distressed expertise and navigating market cycles.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们多年来建立的业绩记录，依靠不良资产专业经验，驾驭市场周期。

subtitles.en: So a lot of our conversations around what's to come, how we're positioned, how right to capitalize on it.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们很多对话都围绕未来走向、我们的定位以及如何把握机会。
